meta_title: Freshstart Landscape Gardening | Manchester Garden Design
meta_description: Freshstart Landscape Gardening transforms Manchester gardens with expert design, planting, and maintenance. Local, reliable, fully insured. Get your free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Garden Experts — 15+ Years Creating Beautiful Outdoor Spaces
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to stunning new patios, we design and build gardens that you'll love living in.
services_heading: Complete Landscape & Garden Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden redesign, routine maintenance, or specialist planting, we've got you covered.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs tailored to your space, budget, and lifestyle. We'll create a detailed plan and 3D visualisation before any work begins, so you know exactly what you're getting.

services.title: Patios, Paths & Decking
services.desc: Expert groundwork and installation of natural stone, porcelain, timber decking, and block paving. Every surface built to last with proper drainage and foundations.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Thoughtful plant selection for colour, texture, and seasonal interest. We handle soil preparation, planting, and aftercare advice so your borders thrive year-round.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular lawn care, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal tidies. Monthly or quarterly visits keep your garden looking smart with minimal effort on your part.

services.title: Fencing, Gates & Screening
services.desc: Professional installation of fences, gates, trellis, and privacy screening. We source quality materials and ensure every post is set solid and level.

services.title: Drainage & Ground Preparation
services.desc: Solve waterlogging and compacted soil issues with proper drainage and land grading. Essential groundwork that prevents costly problems later.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story—we just help you write the next chapter.
about_para_1: Freshstart was founded on a simple idea: gardens should be as beautiful and functional as the homes they surround. Over 15 years, we've transformed over 500 Manchester gardens—from small urban courtyards to sprawling family plots. We're locals who know the clay soils and Manchester weather, and we design with that knowledge baked in.
about_para_2: Our customers come back year after year because we listen more than we talk, deliver on time and on budget, and genuinely care about the finish. Whether you're starting from scratch or refreshing a tired space, we treat your garden with the same attention we'd give our own. You'll be working with experienced gardeners, not just contractors passing through.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Freshstart

reviews.text: We had a complete mess of a back garden—weeds everywhere, broken fence, nowhere to sit. Freshstart sorted it all. The team was brilliant, kept the place tidy while they worked, and the finished garden is exactly what we wanted. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Been using Freshstart for regular maintenance for three years now. Mark and the team always show up on time, the garden looks immaculate, and they're honest about what needs doing and what doesn't. Fair prices too. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Claire P.

reviews.text: New to the area and needed a complete garden redesign. They listened to what we wanted, came back with a brilliant plan, and delivered it on time and within budget. The planting is already settling in nicely. Really professional outfit.
reviews.author: James T.
